text: Builders craft houses, structures, and buildings as experts in their trade. Stone, metal, and wood serve as the raw substances for these functional environments. Mastery of carpentry forms a core requirement for this profession. Construction begins with design layouts and precise measurements before moving to cutting and shaping every timber component until flawless. Joints secured by screws and nails receive treatment with varnish to shield timber against moisture and weather damage. After achieving the intended aesthetic, additional methods enhance the final product's polish and strength.
